description.html: This 35x23x25 cm aquarium (20.1 L) offers enough room for a layout with live plants, roots and stone. The glass is precisely cut and bonded with aquarium silicone, which makes it fully watertight.
The dimensions allow a varied aquascape: wood, stone, live plants and quality substrate. We recommend an external or internal filter, a heater with a thermostat and LED lighting suited to plants.

We make the aquarium by hand, so adjustments are possible: non-standard dimensions, openings for filter hoses, a reinforced bottom for heavier stone. Message us or call for an estimate. Courier delivery throughout Serbia.
